subject: Mid-cycle seat increase & proration / consolidated EU billing
messages:
From: Elena Novak <elena@xenonbio.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@xenonbio.com
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: mid-cycle 4-seat add + VAT / consolidated invoice

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you’re well. We need to add 4 seats to our Dedicated cluster mid-cycle (effective 2027-06-15). We want the additional seats to be billed pro-rata for the remainder of June and then on a monthly cadence thereafter. Two quick questions: 1) Can Redwood issue a single consolidated invoice to our EU parent entity (Xenon Bio Holdings) rather than individual country entities? We have a VAT reverse-charge setup between the parent and subsidiaries and would prefer one invoice to simplify accounting. 2) What evidence do you need from us to apply reverse charge (we can attach VAT certificates).

We also want to confirm payment: we plan to send a SEPA mandate via DocuSign for collection. Is it possible to get an interim invoice for the prorated amount so we can complete the payment prior to the next monthly cycle?

Attaching: company_vat_certificate.pdf

Thanks,
Elena Novak
Head of Finance, Xenon Bio
elena@xenonbio.com

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Novak <elena@xenonbio.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 12:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: mid-cycle 4-seat add + VAT / consolidated invoice

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the VAT certificate. Happy to help; summary & next steps below.

Summary of options
- Consolidated invoice to parent (Xenon Bio Holdings): possible if you confirm the billing_entity_id and supply VAT registration for the parent. Redwood can route all charges to that billing entity and apply reverse-charge where appropriate.
- Interim invoice vs credit on next invoice: we can issue an interim (one-off) invoice for the prorated amount that you can pay by SEPA. Alternatively we can apply the prorate as a credit on the next scheduled invoice; that delays cash collection.

What I need from you
1) Confirm billing_entity_id for Xenon Bio Holdings (or reply with the exact legal entity name and VAT number you want on the invoice).
2) Confirm effective date for the 4-seat add (you indicated 2027-06-15).
3) Confirm preferred flow: interim invoice (pay now) OR consolidated proration credit on July invoice.

I've attached a provisional proration worksheet with the calculation I used (provisional_prorate_calc.xlsx). It assumes seat price of EUR 600/mo and uses a 15–30 June proration window in the example — we’ll update after you confirm the exact start date.

If you want to go with an interim invoice we’ll need the SEPA mandate signed and the billing entity confirmation; once received I’ll ask Finance to generate an invoice with reverse-charge flags.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Kimberly / Marissa — looping in a quick ops note so Finance can prepare the invoice correctly.

Suggested handling (Revenue Ops):
1) Create an interim invoice dated 2027-06-09 (to keep accounting tidy) that itemizes: 4x seats prorated 2027-06-15 through 2027-06-30, unit price EUR 600/month, pro rata factor 16/30 = 0.5333 -> line item: 4 * 600 * 0.5333 = EUR 1,279.92 (rounded).
2) Apply billing_entity = Xenon Bio Holdings and set VAT = 0 with reverse-charge note in invoice footer.
3) Payment terms: SEPA collection once DocuSign mandate returns — mark invoice as "collect via SEPA" and include bank reference.
4) For bookkeeping, code to GL: SaaS Revenue - Prorate (GL: 4002) and Short-term Receivables (GL: 1103). Finance, please confirm GLs and whether we should issue a credit memo on the July invoice or fully close the interim invoice once paid.

Mina, can you confirm you can generate the interim invoice with reverse-charge notes and attach the supporting calculation?
